issue_context.title: Cannot copy/paste to folders that require administrator access.
issue_context.body:
> **Describe the bug**
> When I am trying to copy a file from one folder (Specifically C:/ folder) to another folder (In a C;/ folder only), the app does not show any status or progress and stays idle.
> 
> **To Reproduce**
> Copy a file form C:\Program Files (x86)\Google
>Goto option and try to paste, paste option will be disable
>Close the application and start again. 
>copy the same file again and then go to different folder C:\Program Files (x86)\Mozilla Firefox
> And try to paste in C:\Program Files (x86)\Mozilla Firefox(Or any app folder) you can see now a Paste option unable.
>On Paste It will show blue blink on the process button or stays idle.
>Now it will not copy anything in that folder just seats idle.

> **Expected behaviour**
> It should show the progress of the copying of a file or show a warning or error message if any restrictions or anything.
> 
> **Screenshots**
>
